title: Wizard city homepage — proposal and project facts
content:
# Wizard city homepage — proposal and project facts

Case WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84; screening revision 1. Working draft, not authorized or assessed.

## Resident outcome and boundary
The resident-selected outcome is a city homepage describing management by the Repository City plugin, linking to the plugin and repository, and evoking a wizard city without an Emerald City aesthetic. The selected outcome also includes GitHub Pages enablement and publication, followed by live verification after applicable authorization. Registered scope is city-homepage (`docs`). Intake is not authorization. Do not assume a workflow, domain/address, hosting mechanism, target, change outside docs, or permission increase. Identify and review any required mechanism, outside-docs target, or access before proposing action.

## Candidate and alternatives
Smallest viable candidate: a static homepage and only necessary local assets under docs, with no assumed build dependency. It limits dependencies and maintenance but does not establish host compatibility, target or authority. Alternative: a generated site or publishing mechanism only if verified needs justify the additional dependency, maintenance, access and scope questions. No change avoids new exposure and operating duties but does not deliver the selected outcome. Costs, feasibility and reversibility remain unknown until host and recovery facts are established. No expenditure is proposed or authorized.

## Proposed scope and sequence
1. Establish actual Pages configuration, source, address, restrictions, target, required access and operating facts through authorized read-only investigation.
2. Define a static docs-only interface and exact link destinations; identify any proposed mechanism outside docs separately, without treating it as included.
3. Only after applicable authorization, implement the authorized scope and perform prepublication content, link, responsive, accessibility and exposed-file checks.
4. Obtain separate resident authorization for reserved security/permission changes, Pages enablement, deployment/publication and any expenditure or other reserved matter.
5. Only after publication is separately authorized and an actual public address is confirmed, perform and record the specified live verification. Stop on failed checks or scope drift. Use only a separately authorized recovery/unpublish procedure.
6. Obtain independent delivery inspection and resident final acceptance as separate steps.

## Project facts and evidence limits
The project register maps city-homepage to docs. The district register describes repository ownership, not permission. In the selected workspace view, the visible root contains .city and .git; no docs site, site interface or tests were available to inspect. The .git file points to a worktree Git directory outside the selected root and was not followed. The environment identifies the repository as justin-leis/webe-opolis, but its public URL was not independently verified. The plugin metadata reviewed locally names Repository City but gives no public plugin URL. Neither intended public link destination is confirmed by this review.

Current Pages settings/source/address, account or organization restrictions, exact publication target, dependencies, operator, notification, capacity, costs, unpublishing and recovery are unknown. Earlier Manager observations relayed for predecessor WO-ce0b2be1-7e0c-464b-b17c-814ad36e3ccd are historical and unverified for this case; they are not current evidence. No network, runtime, security, compatibility, accessibility, performance or live test was performed. No external service is treated as a city-owned asset.

## Operational boundary
Public content can expose unintended files or present incorrect/inaccessible information. A failed or stale publication can mislead visitors. Before release, review the actual served content and dependencies, confirm the applicable access model, and identify an accountable operator, notification route and feasible recovery method. These are proposed controls, not evidence that controls currently exist. Do not enable Pages, change access, deploy or publish through this proposal.
